## Mova 1.4.0

Mova 1.4.0 增加实验性的 HTTP/HTTPS `.strm` 支持：媒体库可以识别仅包含一个 HTTP 或 HTTPS 直连媒体地址的 `.strm` 文件，并通过 Mova 的安全代理进行播放。当前不支持 RTSP、MMS、HLS/M3U8、自定义请求头或 Cookie，也不提供远程转码。该能力仍处于实验阶段，如遇到扫描、匹配、拖动播放或兼容性问题，欢迎通过 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/RichesChiu/mova/issues) 或 [Telegram](https://t.me/mova_feedback) 反馈。

本版本同时强化了扫描期间人工元数据操作的并发保护、HTTP/SSE 认证边界、NFO 演员信息优先级、运行配置校验，以及服务端路由、API 文档和官网接口说明之间的自动一致性检查。

数据库迁移 `0004` 和 `0005` 会在启动时自动原地执行，无需重建数据库或缓存。升级后只需重新扫描包含 `.strm` 文件的媒体库；已有本地媒体无需重扫。

---

## Mova 1.4.0

Mova 1.4.0 adds experimental HTTP/HTTPS `.strm` support. Libraries can recognize `.strm` files containing one direct HTTP or HTTPS media URL and play them through Mova's security-aware proxy. RTSP, MMS, HLS/M3U8, custom request headers or cookies, and remote transcoding are not supported. This capability remains experimental; please report scanning, matching, seeking, or compatibility problems through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/RichesChiu/mova/issues) or [Telegram](https://t.me/mova_feedback).

This release also strengthens concurrency protection for manual metadata operations during scans, HTTP/SSE authentication boundaries, NFO cast precedence, runtime configuration validation, and automated consistency checks across server routes, API documentation, and website API content.

Database migrations `0004` and `0005` run automatically in place at startup. No database or cache rebuild is required. Rescan only libraries containing `.strm` files after upgrading; existing local media does not need to be rescanned.
